objective: Implement a deterministic, bounded, outcome-blind historical E-event reconstruction pilot that measures official-evidence reconstruction feasibility and positive-event density without reading any security price or return data.

calendar.rule: For each 2023-2024 calendar quarter, anchor on the 21st joint A-share trading session and query anchor through anchor+6 calendar days inclusive.

discovery_and_selection.collector_semantics: Exact existing 18-term registry, SSE/SZSE routes and announcement_id deduplication; no term changes.
discovery_and_selection.triage: scripts/v284_candidate_triage.py using frozen V2.8.4 narrow administrative-notice skip semantics.
discovery_and_selection.selection_order: SHA256(announcement_id) ascending, then announcement_id ascending as deterministic tie-break.
discovery_and_selection.security_diversity: Within each window, after ordering, keep the first row for each canonical_security_id and stop after six selected rows.

temporal_provenance.announcement_time_interpretation: CNInfo announcement_time must be a finite Unix timestamp in milliseconds or seconds and is converted from UTC to Asia/Shanghai calendar date.
temporal_provenance.path_rule: adjunct_url must remain finalpage/YYYY-MM-DD/<announcement_id>.PDF and its YYYY-MM-DD must equal path_disclosure_date.
temporal_provenance.consistency_rule: Asia/Shanghai calendar date derived from announcement_time must equal path_disclosure_date. Missing, unparsable or conflicting values block temporal provenance for that filing.
temporal_provenance.retrospective_causal_effective_date: First frozen joint A-share trading date strictly after path_disclosure_date.

materialization_and_classification.pdf_validation: Reuse V2.8.4 official PDF validator and SHA256 object binding.
materialization_and_classification.page_text_extraction: Reuse V2.8.4 extractor with physical page provenance.
materialization_and_classification.classifier: Reuse frozen V2.8.4 page-scoped AI-Core classifier and aggregation semantics without changes.

technical: Eight windows are represented by either COMPLETED or explicit WINDOW_SOURCE_BLOCKED status.
Successful classifier-ready materialization rate across selected filings is >= 0.90.
Every reconstructed positive has valid canonical security identity.
Every reconstructed positive has temporal provenance PASS and a conservative next-joint-trading-date retrospective effective date.
Classifier, triage, keyword registry, selection cap and density thresholds are unchanged after classifications.

implementation_validation_required: Self-test recomputes all eight frozen windows from the frozen joint calendar exactly.
Self-test proves deterministic selection is input-order invariant and enforces at most one filing per security per window.
Self-test proves maximum six selected per window and maximum forty-eight globally.
Self-test proves announcement_time/path-date agreement passes and one-day conflict blocks.
Self-test proves retrospective effective date is strictly later than disclosure date and uses the next frozen joint trading date.
Self-test proves missing announcement_time blocks temporal provenance.
Self-test proves no same-day effective date.
Self-test proves outcome/price modules and fold3/fold4 source paths are absent from pilot configuration.
Pilot runner hash and validation receipt must be frozen before any real historical candidate query.
forbidden: No security price, return, benchmark, fold0/1/2 price source, fold3 or fold4 access.
No change to the 18-term collector registry.
No change to classifier/triage semantics after pilot classifications.
No expanding a sparse window, shifting a window, or selecting extra PDFs to rescue positive yield.
No historical reconstructed row appended to the prospective E ledgers.
